exact_contract: Strict exact root and nested fields; versions exactinteger1; pinned canonical profile/catalog/source hashes. Input not mutated. Only solver classical_rk4.

All numeric ODE parameters,dt andstatecomponents are rational STRINGS matching -?(0|nonzero up to9digits)(/positive up to9digits)?; no floats,integers,bools,decimalpoints,exponents or whitespace. Fraction then once converted to IEEE754 binary64. Equivalent rational spellings share mathematics but retain distinct request hashes.

sigma in(0,50],rho in(0,100],beta in(0,20]; each initial component in[-100,100]; exactly3 components. dt in[1/100000,1/20],steps exactinteger0..4096,trace_stride exactinteger1..4096,steps*dt<=50 dimensionless model units.

Explicit base andperturbed initial states; no RNG orimplicit perturbation. Four full integrations: base/perturbed at h andh/2 with N and2N steps. No skipped integration at output stride. Every RK4 intermediate state,derivative andcompleted state mustbe finite andabsolute<=1000000; otherwise reject whole request withoutpartialresult.

Frozen scalar Python binary64 operation order exactly as equations; h*k/2 at stages2/3; h*k atstage4; weighted sum left-to-right; final h/6 multiplication. No adaptive stepping,FMA,vector reassociation orSciPy RK45 substitution.

Nominal aligned times are exact Fraction i*dt strings; actual integration uses float(dt) and float(dt)/2,not rounded accumulated times. Every row has coarse/refined base/perturbed states,their Euclidean separations andeach coarse-refined state difference via math.hypot.

Return initial/final andindices divisible bytrace_stride; diagnostics maxima computed overALL N+1aligned times includingunreturned rows. T0 valid:initialstates only,refinement errors0. Initialzero separation leaves amplification undefined/null; otherwise final_refined_separation/initial_separation,explicitly not Lyapunov exponent.

Preflight work=24*steps derivative evaluations; returned numericcells=17*(numberofreturnedrows),caps100000and100000. Count includes exacttime/index,12statecomponents and4distances. Metadata bounded4000characters. No earlystop/truncation/hiddenhorizon.

Provenance synthetic=true,rights=self_authored,knownsource_ref,nonemptyattribution/snapshot<=4000characters andexactUTF8snapshotSHA. Declarations/hashes do not certify source truth or rights in real data.

Numerical verification: one-step/stages against exactFraction RK4 absolute1e-12; independent local Taylor80/100reference agreement<1e-60,short-horizon convergence observed not analytically bounded; symmetry/fixedpoints anddeterministicreplay. Long chaotic trajectories carry no accuracy certification.

Refinement differences approximate diagnostics,not rigorous errorbounds. State separation isinitial-condition sensitivity,not numericalerror. No global Lyapunov exponent,validated forecast horizon,weather skill,delay embedding,reservoir training or dataassimilation.
